messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — apac-west1 GPU pool (apac-gpu-2) needs a coordinated NIC firmware roll + BMC soft reboots. Target window: Tue 03:00–05:00 UTC. Low-traffic slot but still want to minimize impact to Dedicated tenants.
omar: Rough blast radius? Which pools/nodes exactly?
maya: ~18 racks, two GPU pools: apac-gpu-2-standard (best-effort) and apac-gpu-2-dedicated (reserved). We'll avoid rolling the dedicated pools at the same time as standard; plan is staggered cohorts.
nora: Stagger plan sounds good. Can you post cohort lists and expected eviction counts? We need to notify product for canary customers.
maya: Cohort A = racks 1-6 (standard), Cohort B = racks 7-12 (standard), Cohort C = racks 13-18 (dedicated). Expected pod evictions: ~120 max across cohorts A/B, and ~40 (short lived) for C.
jiro: Annotating SLOs — latency p95 might spike in A/B during KV cache repop; recommend pre-warming prefix cache + increase concurrency limit temporarily.
sam: Can we pre-seed KV caches? If we drain too fast we'll get coldstarts.
maya: Yes — plan includes KV pre-seed job 30m before each cohort uncordon. Command: ```python -m infra.cache_seed --model gpt-small --prefixes-file s3://ops/apac/prefixes-cohortA.txt```

sre-bot: Incident created: #INC-APAC-GPU-NIC-177750 (scheduled maint) — pageresolve: no.
omar: Any customer-facing comms? We should flag Dedicated tenants and those with pinned model versions.
nora: I'll draft an email for Dedicated customers and a short banner for Console. ETA for draft: EOD today.
jiro: Network notes — NIC firmware has a known bug that can cause a brief RX queue stall on ~5% of hosts; we need health checks and quick rollback plan.
maya: Rollback plan: if >3 nodes fail NIC post-update in a cohort, abort remaining nodes and open emergency rollback job. Rollback job is `ops/firmware/rollback_apac.sh`.
sam: Cost question — if we backfill with burst capacity in other regions during the window, estimate bill bump? Ops finance, rough calc: 18 racks * 8 GPUs * 2 hours => ~288 GPU-hours. With cross-region premium that could be ~1.3x normal. We should limit cross-region backfill to critical tokens only.
omar: Agree. Let's set autoscale policy to prefer local burst standby first, then fall back to cross-region only if utilization >85%.
maya: Preflight checklist (short):
- notify Dedicated via email + console banner (nora)
- cohort lists posted to runbook (mai)
- KV pre-seed jobs ready (sam)
- healthcheck dashboards pinned (jiro)
- rollback script tested in staging (omar)
- oncall assigned (maya)

sam: I'll run a dry-run of the pre-seed job against a staging cache tomorrow 02:30 UTC.
jiro: I'll create a Grafana dashboard panel for per-cohort p95 and NIC error counters and pin it to the runbook.
maya: Oncall: @sam (primary), @omar (secondary). Please be available 02:45–06:00 UTC Tue.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h before window and 1h before window.
omar: One more ask — can we set a short-lived QOS cap on best-effort pool to protect Dedicated during the cohort C work? 1 minute throttle window during uncordon might help.
nora: Good idea. Ops policy update: set `qos.concurrency_limit` for standard pool to 60% for 15m post-uncordon. I'll patch the policy and include in runbook.
maya: Thanks all — I'll drop final cohort schedule and runbook link here after EOD. Ping me if you want to join the ops call during the window. :thumbsup:
